# Encoding

The Unicode (UTF-8, UTF-16BE, UTF-16LE) can be supported from Tera Term 4.102.
UTF-8 is recommended. cf. "[About Tera Term 5](https://teratermproject.github.io/manual/5/en/html/usage/migrate_to_5.html#migrate_macro)" page.

The TTL file was processed as ANSI CodePage in previous version.

## 2) Encoding determination

Tera Term determines the encoding as follows.

**When BOM exists**

Tera Term determines one of UTF-8, UTF-16BE and UTF-16LE from BOM type, next reading the file.

**When BOM does not exist**

Reading the file as UTF-8. Reading the file as CP_ACP (same as before 4.102) when the file can not be decoded as UTF-8.
